lead_raw_text:
The structure of NbClO4 adopts the triclinic space group P-1 (No. 2), with a 12-atom unit cell containing three Nb, three Cl, and six O atoms across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Nb-centered octahedral environments with six O neighbors each, while Cl centers show eight geometric neighbors (three Cl and five O). O-centered octahedra connect to one Cl and two Nb neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner- and edge-sharing between Nb and O octahedra and among O octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
